outcome: mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery, Caesarean section, operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 3300 pregnant women with singleton fetuses between 37-42 weeks of gestation.
finding: Both long and short umbilical cords are associated with a higher rate of operative vaginal delivery and caesarean section, with nuchal cords being more common in the long umbilical cord group.
mod_finding: Both long and short umbilical cords are associated with higher rates of operative vaginal delivery and caesarean section.
